hero.lede: I design how software gets built: the architecture, the standards and now the AI tools behind it.

about.heading: About
about.p1: I'm an architect and engineering leader with 21 years of taking systems from the first whiteboard sketch to production. Most recently I helped AMH rethink how its developers work, bringing in AI tools like Claude and MCP servers, automated DevOps and earlier security checks. I built the tooling and trained developers across the company to use it.
about.p2: I'm good at getting different teams pulling in the same direction, setting standards that stick, and shaping how teams hire and test. I've worked in banking, real estate, marketing, logistics, procurement, government, healthcare and e-learning. I'm based in Salt Lake City and work in English and Spanish.

privacy.title: Privacy
p: When you ask for my resume on this site, I keep what you type: your name, email, company, role and, if you add it, how you found me. I also keep whether you checked “Rod may contact me”, and when.
I use it to give you the resume link. If you checked the box, I may also reach out to you about it. I don't use it for anything else, and it's never sold or shared.
Everything is stored in my own database (Supabase). Your IP address is never stored; I keep only a salted hash of it to limit abuse.
If you checked the box, I keep your details for 12 months. If you didn't, I keep them for 90 days. Blocked or automated requests are kept for 90 days.
To see or delete what I hold about you, email {email}. I'll answer within 30 days.
This site has no analytics, ads or third-party trackers, so it doesn't respond to Do Not Track signals; there's nothing to turn off.
